messages:
maya: Heads-up 1 I pushed a fresh Figma for the API keys panel—mostly rotate/revoke flows + empty state. Looking for quick feedback on copy, keyboard flow, and accessibility. https://figma.com/file/def456 (placeholder)
eli: Quick thing: primary CTA should be explicit. Current `Rotate` reads like an action list item. Recommend `Rotate key` or `Rotate this key`.
jordan: We should show a tiny `Used by 2 apps` line under each key. Add a `View usage` link that opens a small drawer so people can confirm before rotating.
nora: A11y notes: after rotation announce with aria-live="polite": "New API key generated. Use the reveal control to view the key." Do NOT read the raw key aloud. Add aria-describedby linking to helper text that explains one-time visibility.
sam: Focus & timer: modal traps correctly today but we need deterministic focus after success. Suggest: focus the `Copy new key` button inside the success panel, start a 20s timer, and show an undo snackbar for revoke actions.
maya: How long should the key be visible? On mobile copy can be fiddly0s feels safe. Show explicit helper: "This is the only time the full key will be shown."
eli: Copy text: avoid one-word toasts. Use full sentence: "API key copied to clipboard." Also ensure Copy button has accessible name `Copy new API key` and polite aria-live updates.
sam: Backend exposes resp.one_time_key. Frontend snippet we can reuse: 
```
if (resp.one_time_key) {
  showOneTimeKey(resp.key)
  startTimer(20000)
}
```
Consider requiring a 500ms press-to-reveal on mobile to avoid shoulder-surf.
jordan: Revoke UX: for keys used by 3+ apps, require a typed confirmation (enter key name) or checkbox `I understand this will break integrations`. Keep default flow lighter for single-use keys. Also show `Undo` in snackbar for 30s after revoke.
nora: Visual nits: don't rely on red alone for destructive label. Add alert icon + visually hidden text `Danger: revoke API key` for screen readers. Ensure contrast meets AA.
maya: Empty state copy: current blunt: `You have no API keys yet.` Suggest friendlier and action-first: `No API keys yet 1 Create one to get started with the API` with primary CTA `Create key`. Add a small link to docs `How to use keys` (opens in new tab).
eli: Small accessibility tweak: ensure keyboard users can reveal and copy without needing the mouse. Reveal should be a button in tab order; holding the reveal key shouldn't remove it from the tab sequence.
sam: Telemetry idea: record whether users click `Rotate` then `Copy` within 30s; flag cases where they rotate but never copy (might indicate broken clipboard). We'll add an event `keys.rotate_copy` with boolean copied.
jordan: Copy A/B variants for the modal body (we should run quick experiment):
Variant Short: "Rotate key — a new key will be created and the old key invalidated."
Variant Explicit: "Rotate key now — this will immediately invalidate the existing key. Update any integrations that use it."
nora: I favor Explicit for accessibility and support load reasons.
maya: OK I'll update the file in Figma with ARIA notes (aria-live regions, focus target ids, reveal timing) and add the usage drawer. Will post screenshots once done. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 23:15 PST (automated:deploy)
maya: Created ticket KEYUX-412 and assigned to @sam. ETA: next sprint.
